notes.title: DevLog: New map animations, sounds and updated mechanics!
notes.content:
Hello, this week we've focused on making some of under-used mechanics and improving UI and audio  of the game!

Changelog v 0.6.6

Added
* New UI sounds
* New Map animations (cars, billboards, etc.)

Fixed
* Various interface bugs.
* Improved text and fixed typos

Improved
* We relaxed the Upgrade and Reduce Fear actions to assign up to 3 Staff members to meet skill requirement.
* Improved visual features and functionality of the menu.
